decisions.reason: It is still presented on its own page and, in long-cycle space markets, a core camera product with uncertain but plausible demand is worth keeping as a low-cost option.
The reported ESA HERA mission launch is strong market validation, so the product has moved beyond a pure option and merits continued support.
It remains actively presented and extends the firm's sensor capabilities into a relevant adjacent field, so uncertainty is still worth bearing rather than forcing an early exit.
Even with weaker public evidence, a miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR fits the firm's miniaturization direction and is likely inexpensive to keep available while customer interest develops.
Because it was launched only in 2024 and already has a dedicated page, management would keep this close-to-core product on the market until more information about its value emerges.
As a 2024 launch in a specialized but strategically relevant navigation niche, it is too early to abandon and sensible to retain as an exploratory option.
